title: Data Center Matrix Validation
description:
A cloud datacenter uses a 9x9 grid layout to map server rack switch IDs. Each cell contains a character digit from '1' to '9' representing an active channel, or '.' representing an unconfigured slot. Validate whether the current grid configuration meets the following rules:
1. Each row must contain the digits '1'-'9' without duplicates.
2. Each column must contain the digits '1'-'9' without duplicates.
3. Each of the nine 3x3 sub-grids must contain the digits '1'-'9' without duplicates.
Note: An unconfigured slot ('.') is considered valid and should be ignored.
output_format: Return true if the grid layout is valid, otherwise return false.

examples.explanation: All filled cells satisfy the uniqueness requirements in rows, columns, and 3x3 sub-grids.
The top-left cell contains '8', which conflicts with the existing '8' at row 3, column 0 in the first column.
An empty board contains no duplicate digit conflicts, so it is valid.
